name: method
description: A method or constructor of a Java type. Its key is the declaring type's binary name, '#', the method's name (<init> for a constructor) and its erased parameter types in parentheses, such as com.example.Order#total(java.lang.String,int[]).

name: field
description: A field or enum constant of a Java type. Its key is the declaring type's binary name, '#' and the field's name.

name: kind
description: What sort of thing the subject is. For a Java type: class, interface, enum, record or annotation. For a schema: how it is migrated, flyway, liquibase or sql (other SQL files), one fact for each.
